description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyListRestController class, which handles REST API requests related to a list of job vacancies within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides a method to process GET requests to fetch vacancy data with filtering, sorting, and pagination support, but other HTTP methods are not implemented.
